hero.subText: Type-First Build Compilation with Runtime Orchestration
hero.description: Pristine TypeScript types compiled into live runtime blueprints. Zero schema duplication, zero bundle inflation.

blockOne.description: Xalor is a build-time TypeScript engine that transforms native types into a live runtime system for validation, generation, and transformation — without duplicating schemas or shipping heavy validation libraries.

blockTwo.description: Unlike **Zod** or **Yup** which require writing heavy runtime schemas, or macro generators like **Typia** which clutter your git history with generated files, Xalor uses a silent background compiler watcher to turn pristine TypeScript interfaces into optimized runtime maps.
list: _The Result_ Use them natively at runtime.

one.description: Handle external API inputs cleanly with flexible runtime safety boundaries.

two.description: Generate type-safe mocks, staging state objects, or default templates out of thin air.

three.description: Manipulate object shapes inline at runtime using type properties as commands.

four.description: Eliminate the manual schema-updating workflow forever. When you modify your interface, your runtime behavior changes natively on the very next compilation step.

installation.description: Set up the core package using your preferred node dependency tool chain.
installation.footnote: Note: Because Xalor handles type extraction in the background, your environment needs to include our bundler transformer setup during your normal _pnpm build_ or _vite build_ process.
installation.codeBlock:
npm install @bgskinner2/xalor
pnpm add @bgskinner2/xalor
yarn add @bgskinner2/xalor

requirements.description: You must register the transformation plugin inside your _tsconfig.json_ file. For advanced environment configurations, see the Full Setup Guide.

list: Eliminates the _Dual-Source Tax_- Write your data definitions precisely once. Stop maintaining matching type interfaces and validation schemas concurrently.
Massive Client Bundle Reduction- Moves data model parsing completely to the build stage. Production apps inherit tiny metadata maps rather than thousands of lines of heavy validation parsing logic.
GPS Telemetry Traceability- When an object fails matching rules, Xalor flags the exact file path and line location of the target TypeScript source code instead of throwing unhelpful generic errors.

compilationLifecycle.title: The Three-Phase Compilation Lifecycle
compilationLifecycle.body:
When you press save (`Cmd+S`) or trigger a production build, Xalor’s compiler plugin hooks directly into the native TypeScript Compiler API pipeline pass, routing your files through a strict, three-tiered execution track:

* **1. The Interception (Scout Pass):** Before a file is ever handed over to heavy token traversal layers, **The Scout** executes a dependency-free, high-velocity string token scan for framework triggers. If a file does not explicitly invoke the engine, it is short-circuited and bypassed entirely in **less than 1 microsecond**.
* **2. The Extraction (Miner Pass):** If triggers are detected, **The Miner** sweeps the file, extracts the raw TypeScript structural AST data, and updates the active Live RAM Vault instantly, ensuring your development server reflects your new models with zero boot latency.
* **3. The Compaction (Banker Pass):** Before exiting the loop, the **Banker** handles **Deep Graph Interning**. It calculates structural content hashes, deduplicates identical sub-properties, and atomically writes an optimized, single-file cache snapshot down to `.cache/xalor/vault-snapshot.json`.

typeReification.title: Ambient Type Reification
typeReification.body:
Traditional frameworks rely on runtime JavaScript schema declarations to enforce data boundaries. Xalor bypasses this abstraction entirely, operating as a true **Type Reification Engine** that hooks directly into the native TypeScript Compiler API pass.

### 🧬 AST Compilation Mechanics
The transformer unrolls complex static type definitions (primitive literals, maps, records, and deep interfaces) point-free through a cascade of self-cleaning type-predicate reifiers. By mapping your data structures to `summary.totalRegisteredKeys` and `summary.totalUniqueFingerprints`, the engine evaluates your code geometry instantly. Shared object models are processed exactly once and assigned a deterministic structural content hash, completely preventing cache bloat and compiler heap pressure as your codebase expands.

twinMapBioDirectional.body: Xalor secures your system workspace using a **Twin-Map Bidirectional Metadata Matrix**. Instead of running expensive recursive searches, the framework maintains an in-memory process ledger caching the absolute spatial geometry and cryptographic footprints of active type declarations via isolated, inverse dictionaries: Key-to-Anchor (`keys`) and Anchor-to-Key (`anchors`). This dual structure allows the compiler to trace, audit, and cross-examine namespace conflicts from opposite directions simultaneously at **sub-nanosecond execution speeds** without touching physical disk sectors, instantly intercepting cross-file namespace hijacking during active development.

transformationAnalysis.title: Code Transformation Analysis (The Phantom Clean)

dualSourceTax.title: Eliminating the Dual-Source Tax
dualSourceTax.body:
Writing application code shouldn't force you to maintain duplicate files. Legacy approaches require you to code a custom validation schema language block and manually type-sync a mirrored TypeScript interface beside it. Xalor terminates this tax by treating your native types as the absolute Single Source of Truth.

### 🧼 Build-Time Registry Sanitization
Our engine maps active functional strategy invocations (`guard`, `assert`, `parse`, `mock`, `audit`) repository-wide. If you delete an API endpoint or refactor code paths, the background watcher catches the mutation and flags stale keys within the `telemetry.orphanedKeys` registry cache ledger. Executing the CLI with the optional `--fix` or `-f` flag triggers an **Auto-Prune Sweep**, permanently purging dead-weight keys from your global registry map instantly to maintain pristine source hygiene.

bundleComparison.title: Bundle & Compaction Analysis
bundleComparison.body:
Traditional validation frameworks scale bundle weights linearly; managing 100+ data models clutters production artifacts with thousands of lines of property trees. Xalor strips away heavy inline type parameters, leaving behind an exceptionally lean runtime blueprint.

### 🧪 Lifecycle Metadata Evaporation Deltas
Our `PackageLifecycleAuditor` service evaluates your project down to the byte. By contrasting `lifecycleFootprint.developmentCacheBytes` directly against `productionEstimatedBytes`, you can monitor your active **Metadata Evaporation Delta**. The compilation sweep permanently trims fat away—purging spatial IDE telemetry and layout metrics to achieve a **57.3% to 92.0% volume reduction**, collapsing schemas down to a flat _11.60KB bare-metal package base_ with a tight _0.8KB instance footprint_.

Multiprocessor.body: When running local development environments, your terminal watch loop daemon and your IDE shadow server (`tsserver`) operate as completely separate, asynchronous processes. Saving a file triggers concurrent compilation passes, introducing severe disk write-contention race conditions. Xalor eliminates this vulnerability by deploying an automated write barrier called **The Atomic Shield**. The engine completely rejects direct, volatile filesystem overrides. It flushes the content-addressable JSON snapshot matrix into an isolated, randomized temporary file handle (`vault-snapshot.json.xxxx.tmp`) before executing a single native operating-system atomic rename operation (`fs.renameSync`) to seal the target base cache and **permanently prevent database file truncation or split-second corruption bugs**.

Ghost Emitter.subHeader: ### 🌉 The Ghost Emitter Type Injection Bridge
Ghost Emitter.body: Because Xalor requires developers to pass string literal keys (`xalor.validate<'USER'>()`) to drive high-speed runtime lookups, developers would traditionally lose standard code-editor intellisense protections for those strings. Xalor solves this natively by deploying an automated build-time type generator called **The Ghost Emitter**. Every time the persistence gate flushes an update, the transformer automatically intercepts the stream and dynamically writes a specialized declaration file (`.cache/xalor/solid-env.d.ts`) directly into your project's node modules tree. This file performs native **TypeScript Declaration Merging**, dynamically injecting your newly saved string keys straight into the global autocomplete registry maps silently with **absolute zero source folder pollution**.

Ambient Environment Bootstrap.body: Xalor completely eliminates initial onboarding toolchain setup friction. There are zero post-install setup commands to trigger, no hidden binary scripts to run, and no complex shell setups (`npx xalor init`) required to map paths. The framework manages its own initialization lifecycle silently via a defensive **Cold-Start Guard**. The exact millisecond your code editor opens your project and loads our plugin, the hydration engine checks your filesystem cache tracks. If it detects a brand new installation with no existing database, it instantly handles directory tree creation and copies a ready-to-go, empty placeholder type bridge straight onto your local hard drive, **erasing red IDE typing error underlines before your very first file compilation sweep is ever executed**.

leaderShipGuarantees.title: Ecosystem Safety & Hygiene Guarantees
leaderShipGuarantees.body:
Xalor enforces strict, deterministic constraints to protect large engineering monorepos, micro-frontends, and serverless V8 edge deployments from structural degradation and runtime anomalies.

### 🚨 Pipeline Concurrency & Fail-Safes
* **The AST Recursion Brake:** Self-referencing graphs or circular dependencies risk crashing standard build watchers. Xalor monitors your layout hierarchy depth; the microsecond a pass crosses our defensive boundary, the engine activates an emergency brake, drops out of the tree, and injects an explicit reference terminal node into `hygiene.depthWarnings` to prevent dangerous thread lockups.
* **Contract Drift Radar:** Enforces CI/CD pipeline invariants against production snapshots. If a destructive mutation occurs (e.g., a field type changing from `string` to `number`), the engine logs the failure inside the `drift.mutations` ledger, terminating the execution with exit code `1` to block corrupt contracts from reaching live deployment environments.

Namespace Specification.title: The Global Namespace Specification
Namespace Specification.body:
In highly distributed or modular architectures—such as monorepos, micro-frontends, or modern serverless runtimes—explicitly passing around database handles or importing monolithic registry instances creates tight coupling and module cross-contamination risks. Xalor solves this by anchoring its state to an isolated global runtime memory proxy.

### ⚡ O(1) Memory Hydration Map
Every time the system boots up and runs `hydrateFromGenesis`, the framework completely bypasses local module variables. Instead, it binds its active lookup maps directly to a strictly guarded, global singleton instance at `globalThis.__SOLID_VAULT__`.

This global pointer map translates identically across all modern V8 execution engines. By shifting structural indexing entirely into build-time execution, deployment targets such as **AWS Lambda, Vercel Edge Functions, and Cloudflare Workers** remain lightweight, runtime-silent, and startup-optimized—**dropping serverless cold starts to practically absolute zero**.
